# SHA-256 of the actionlint release archives CI downloads (.github/actions/actionlint), in the
# format `sha256sum` writes and reads. Same reasoning as .github/task-checksums.txt: the binary
# lands on PATH, and a release asset can be replaced after the fact; a hash recorded here cannot.
#
# Why not `go tool` from server/go.mod like the other Go tools: in the server's module graph
# go.yaml.in/yaml/v4 resolves to a release candidate actionlint 1.7.12 does not compile against
# (28 November 2026). Locally: `go install github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v<version>`.
#
# When .tool-versions moves `actionlint` to a new version, add its line. Upstream publishes the
# value in the release's checksums file (and GitHub shows it as the asset's digest):
#   v=1.7.12
#   curl -fsSL "https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v$v/actionlint_${v}_checksums.txt" \
#     | grep linux_amd64.tar.gz
8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8  actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz
